title: MLCC Tune Technique Manifest
description: Per-technique tuning descriptor (BL129). The single source of truth for a managed-customization technique's reward kind, PEFT variants, dataset contract, and hyperparameter knobs. Two provenance-tagged layers: a hand-authored STRUCTURAL layer (reward_source, per-variant peft/artifact_kind/dataset_contract) and a SYNCED layer (per-variant hyperparameters + _synced) written by scripts/sync-model-families.js from AWS's recipe override-params. Mirrors templates/code/serve.d/manifest.schema.json (ADR-004 / ADR-008: derive, don't hardcode). The do/tune config UX (BL128), the register-side producer, and the do/tune preflight all read THIS file so they cannot disagree.

syncedProvenance.description: Where a backend's synced hyperparameter block came from, so a refresh is idempotent and auditable.

from.description: The S3 URI of the override-params object this block was synced from (e.g. s3://jumpstart-cache-prod-us-west-2/recipes/..._override_params_sm_jobs_v2.2.7.json).

version.description: The override-params object version (semver). The sync is a no-op when this is unchanged.

workload_kind.description: Wave 11 (R9.3), hp-eks only: the workload kind of AWS's HP-EKS payload template, read by sync from the template's `kind:`. do/tune --backend hp-eks runs HyperPodPyTorchJob variants and refuses RayJob (needs KubeRay, post-2.0).

hyperparameter.description: One synced knob. `type` and `required` are ALWAYS present (so the do/tune consumer can enforce required-knob behavior and type validation). `default` is OPTIONAL — a required knob may legitimately have none, in which case the builder prompts for it. `control` and `tier` are OPTIONAL — the leaner MTRL override-params omit them, and the do/tune builder DERIVES them when absent (enum -> dropdown, min/max -> number_input, else text_input; default tier primary). The canonical key names are `control` (synced from the override-param `control_type`) and `tier` (from `visibility_tier`); the sync does the rename.

type.description: The knob's value type (from the override-param `type`).

required.description: Whether the knob must have a value. Defaults to false when the override-param omits it.

default.description: The knob's default value, when the override-param provides one. Type matches `type`. Absent when the source carries no default.

min.description: Inclusive lower bound for a numeric knob, where the source declares one.

max.description: Inclusive upper bound for a numeric knob, where the source declares one.

step.description: Numeric step, where the source declares one.

enum.description: The allowed choice-list, where the source declares one (drives a dropdown).

control.description: The input widget (synced from the override-param `control_type`). OPTIONAL; the builder derives it when absent.

tier.description: Progressive-disclosure tier (synced from the override-param `visibility_tier`). OPTIONAL; the builder derives `primary` when absent.

display_name.description: Human-readable label (where the source declares one).

description.description: One-line help text (where the source declares one).

hint.description: Short input hint (where the source declares one).

variant.description: A PEFT variant of the technique (keyed 'lora' or 'full'). Carries the hand-authored structural fields plus the synced hyperparameters/_synced blocks. `peft` -> `artifact_kind` is schema-enforced so the artifact classification cannot drift from the recipe's PEFT mode.

artifact_kind.description: The output artifact kind, DERIVED from `peft` (lora -> lora_adapter, none -> full_model) and enforced below. Declared here so later waves (BL136/BL137 registry metadata, the do/adapter filter, the three-way deploy split) consume it; BL129 only DECLARES it.

hyperparameters.description: SYNCED. Per-knob map written by sync-model-families (category:hyperparameter for the tagged flavor; denylist-filtered for the leaner MTRL flavor). Never hand-edited. Empty {} before the first sync.

_synced.description: SYNCED. Per-backend provenance for the hyperparameters block. A map keyed by backend so a technique present on only one backend (MTRL is SMTJ-only: HpEksOverrideParamsS3Uri is None) validates with just that key. Empty {} in a pre-sync (hand-authored) descriptor; populated with the backends that exist after sync-model-families runs. The conformance test (not the schema) asserts a synced descriptor carries at least `smtj`.

then.description: A LoRA variant produces a LoRA adapter artifact.
A full-rank variant produces a full-model artifact.

datasetContract.description: STRUCTURAL. The required training-data shape for this technique+variant — the contract the register-side producer writes against and the do/tune preflight validates against. `reward_model_style` is present ONLY for the verl-5field schema (enforced below).

format.description: On-the-wire format the managed trainer reads. verl-based RL techniques are parquet; sft/dpo are jsonl.

schema.description: The row schema. verl-5field = {data_source, prompt, ability, reward_model{style,ground_truth}, extra_info}. mtrl-rollout is the agent_env/rollout shape (unverified).

prompt_shape.description: How the `prompt` column is shaped. message-list = [{role,content},...] (what verl's RLHFDataset wants); string = flattened. Managed RL uses message-list.

reward_model_style.description: The verl reward_model.style the producer stamps per row. rule = verifiable ground-truth reward (rlvr); model = judge/model-scored reward (rlaif). Present ONLY for verl-5field (see if/then). Derived from the technique's reward_source, not hardcoded.

verified.description: Whether MLCC has verified this row schema against a real job. false for mtrl-rollout (its shape is declared-unverified until exercised — BL139).

then.description: A verl-5field dataset MUST declare its reward_model_style; the field is meaningless (and omitted) for the other schemas.

else.description: Non-verl-5field schemas MUST NOT carry reward_model_style.

technique.description: Technique id; matches the plugin directory name (governance cross-check in validate-tune-manifests.js). The enum mirrors KNOWN_TECHNIQUES (src/lib/managed-techniques.js).

reward_source.description: The reward mechanism family. none (sft), preset (dpo preference), rule (rlvr verifiable reward), judge (rlaif LLM-as-judge), agent_env (mtrl rollout). Drives the dataset_contract.reward_model_style derivation (rule/preset -> rule, judge -> model) so the style lives in one place.

variants.description: PEFT variants of this technique, keyed 'lora' and/or 'full'. A technique that ships only LoRA (mtrl) has just the 'lora' key.
